title: Conservative Meta-Agent Search: Architecture Adaptation under Non-Stationarity
abstract: arXiv:2610.31436v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated agentic-system design is typically evaluated on static task suites with immediate scalar rewards. Deployed systems face persistent shift, delayed dependent feedback, correlated component failures, and costly architecture changes. We formalize meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints and introduce Conservative Meta-Agent Search (CMAS). CMAS retrieves archived architectures and proposes typed graph edits, then scores each against the incumbent by paired shadow replay under common random numbers, with interventional component credit. Promotion requires an empirically calibrated, variance-penalized simultaneous score above a pre-specified margin, and is followed by a simulated canary stage and pre-specified rollback. Since backtests cannot certify meta-level skill, we introduce MetaInvest-Bench, a regime-switching simulator whose specified worker competence

translated_title: 保守元智能体搜索：非平稳性下的架构自适应
translated_abstract: 自动化智能体系统设计通常在具有即时标量奖励的静态任务套件上进行评估。然而实际部署的系统面临持续的环境漂移、延迟且相互依赖的反馈、组件间的相关性故障以及代价高昂的架构变更。我们将元智能体架构搜索形式化为带有切换成本和硬风险约束的序贯现任者替换问题，并提出保守元智能体搜索（CMAS）。CMAS从存档中检索架构并生成类型化的图编辑，随后在共同随机数条件下通过配对影子回放并结合干预式组件信用归因，将每个候选架构与现任架构进行对比评分。候选架构的晋升需要其经验校准的、经方差惩罚的同步得分超过预先指定的裕度，晋升后还需经过模拟金丝雀阶段并配备预先指定的回滚机制。鉴于回测无法证明元层面的能力，我们引入了MetaInvest-Bench——一个状态切换模拟器，其指定的工作者能力……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出保守元智能体搜索（CMAS），将非平稳环境下的元智能体架构搜索形式化为带切换成本与硬风险约束的序贯现任者替换问题，通过配对影子回放评分、方差惩罚晋升裕度、金丝雀验证与回滚机制实现安全稳健的架构自适应，并配套引入MetaInvest-Bench状态切换模拟基准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Conservative Meta-Agent Search (CMAS), which formalizes meta-agent architecture search under non-stationarity as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints, achieving safe architecture adaptation through paired shadow replay scoring, variance-penalized promotion margins, simulated canary stages, and pre-specified rollback, evaluated on the MetaInvest-Bench regime-switching simulator.
